procedure: Create a new empty study output directory on the registered server; preserve existing runs.
Copy each arm source,config,gates and registration into a separate new subdirectory. Keep source,seed,schedule,learning_rate,mu,loss weights and warm-start checkpoint unchanged.
Assign new phase identifiers and current call-number offsets; update only the resulting config hashes in the new registration. Register both arms before executing.
In each new arm directory execute: python3 -B signed_response_pilot.py. Run arms serially with2CPUthreads and the same CUDA deterministic configuration supplied by the entrypoint.
Evaluate only the final80updatecheckpoint with the frozen gates; retain every result and failed gate.
inference_replay: The saved replay source reproduced the null and negative60e frame for each completed checkpoint without labels; all4 maps were bitwise identical. This verifies checkpoint inference repeatability; the80-update training was not run a second time.
scope: Development fixture only; independent experimental/hardware validation not performed.
